end

local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

local function okay(character)
    task.spawn(function()
        while character and character.Parent do
            local ms = character:GetAttribute("MaxStamina") or 100
            character:SetAttribute('Stamina', ms)
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end)
end

if lp.Character then
    okay(lp.Character)
end

print("fpe sucks")

--// Anti-Kick
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function Notify(title, text, duration)
    StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = title,
        Text = text,
        Duration = duration or 5
    })
end

local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
setreadonly(mt, false)
local old = mt.__namecall

mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
    local method = getnamecallmethod()
    if self == LocalPlayer and (method == "Kick" or method == "kick") then
        Notify("🚫 Anti-kick", "A Kick Command Blocked!", 5)
        return nil
    end
    return old(self, ...)
end)

LocalPlayer.Kick = function(...)
    Notify("🚫 Anti-Kick", "A direct kick command was blocked!", 5)
end

Allows you to play fake emotes, visible but everyone and heard by no one
yeah, it will not have sounds or any cosmetics that emote was gonna give
(like the scarf in aura farming etc.)
scripts.script:
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawz.vercel.app/skidlib.txt"))()
local plr       = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char      = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hum       = char.Humanoid
local animator  = hum:WaitForChild("Animator")
local All_Anims = {}
local Anim_Names = {}
local Anim_By_Name = {}
local rs             = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local track
local Animaxor_Selected

local function Play(animaxor)
     track = animator:LoadAnimation(animaxor)
	 track:Play()
end

function StopAnimation()
	for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
		track:Stop()
	end
end

for _, animation in ipairs(rs:GetDescendants()) do
	if animation:IsA("Animation")  and 
	animation.Name == "Animation"  and
	animation.Parent:IsA("Folder") then
		table.insert(All_Anims, animation)

		local name = animation.Parent.Name
		table.insert(Anim_Names, name)

		Anim_By_Name[name] = animation
	end
end

local Window = Library:CreateWindow({
    Title = "// Animaxxing",
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(123,45.6,78.90)
   -- 1234567890 aura
})

local MainTab = Window:CreateTab({ Name = "Animaxor", Icon = "person-play" })


MainTab:CreateDropdown({
    Name = "ANIMAXXORS",
    Options = Anim_Names,
    Multi = false,
    Callback = function(selected)
        Animaxor_Selected = Anim_By_Name[selected]
    end
})

MainTab:CreateButton({
	Name = "Play Selected",
	Callback = function() Play(Animaxor_Selected) end
})

MainTab:CreateButton({
	Name = "Stop Animations",
	Callback = function() StopAnimation() end
})

Library:Notify({
	Title = "// Animaxxing",
	Content = "Dance",
	Duration = 5})
